findings.title: The regression test never exercises the batch-flush path it describes
findings.claim: The regression test never exercises the batch-flush path it describes. The loopback sink it wraps does not support batch flushes, so the stream's write_buf flushes synchronously and the ~output_stream `!_in_batch` crash cannot occur in this test.

findings.title: Two test comments describe behavior that never happens in this fixture: the 'batch flush…
findings.claim: Two test comments describe behavior that never happens in this fixture: the 'batch flush poller' yield loop and the closing note that ~output_stream() asserts on a pending batch flush.

findings.title: The test does not assert that the send_empty_frame hook was refused with closed_error
findings.claim: The test does not assert that the send_empty_frame hook was refused with closed_error. A hook that succeeds is silently accepted.

findings.title: The test has unbounded waits, and its cleanup can be skipped: an early exception or…
findings.claim: The test has unbounded waits, and its cleanup can be skipped: an early exception or failed REQUIRE leaves the parked close() unreleased, so teardown hangs instead of failing.

findings.title: The test holds a reference into a growable std::vector and relies on the stream's hook…
findings.claim: The test holds a reference into a growable std::vector and relies on the stream's hook being at a fixed position.

findings.title: No test covers the second half of the fix: stream_close() waiting for…
findings.claim: No test covers the second half of the fix: stream_close() waiting for _outgoing_queue_ready to drain entries accepted before _stream_closing was set.

findings.title: The new docs say any exception thrown while reading a source closes it
findings.claim: The new docs say any exception thrown while reading a source closes it. That is false for exceptions thrown while deserializing a buffer.

findings.title: The new doc says a stream's connection is shut down 'only once both halves are closed'
findings.claim: The new doc says a stream's connection is shut down 'only once both halves are closed'. That contradicts the client-close abort described a few lines earlier and the error/peer-eof paths in the client loop.

findings.title: The stream_close() comment says nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready
findings.claim: The stream_close() comment says nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready. In fact stop_send_loop() still awaits it, and suspend_for_testing() calls .get() on it.

findings.title: The new doxygen blocks are placed above the old plain comments `// send data Out
findings.claim: The new doxygen blocks are placed above the old plain comments `// send data Out...` and `// receive data In...`, leaving two descriptions of each class.

findings.title: The test factory uses const_cast inside a const override to record hooks, instead of…
findings.claim: The test factory uses const_cast inside a const override to record hooks, instead of declaring the member mutable.

findings.title: The new `_stream_closing` flag repeats state already held by `_sink_closed_future` and…
findings.claim: The new `_stream_closing` flag repeats state already held by `_sink_closed_future` and `_error`, and send() now has to check two flags (`!_error && !_stream_closing`) to know whether the connection is still usable.

findings.title: stream_close() now repeats stop_send_loop()'s 'wait for _outgoing_queue_ready, ignore…
findings.claim: stream_close() now repeats stop_send_loop()'s 'wait for _outgoing_queue_ready, ignore its exception, then write_buf.close()' sequence, including the explanatory comment.

findings.title: The lambda parameter `future<> f` in stream_close() shadows the enclosing local `auto f`
findings.claim: The lambda parameter `future<> f` in stream_close() shadows the enclosing local `auto f`.

findings.title: The test stores a reference to an element of the growable `std::vector` `hooks` (`auto&…
findings.claim: The test stores a reference to an element of the growable `std::vector` `hooks` (`auto& stream_send_empty_frame = client_factory.hooks.back();`), and `negotiate()` keeps pushing to that vector.

findings.title: The closing test comment says dropping sink and source 'is where ~output_stream()…
findings.claim: The closing test comment says dropping sink and source 'is where ~output_stream() asserts' without the fix. But the test's wrapped put() always completes, so the test never reproduces that assertion. It only detects the write.

findings.title: `st
findings.claim: `st.close_entered_cv.wait(...)` has no timeout. If stream_close() is ever not triggered by sink.close(), the test hangs instead of failing.

findings.title: The test uses a magic count of 10 `yield()` calls to 'let the batch flush poller run'
findings.claim: The test uses a magic count of 10 `yield()` calls to 'let the batch flush poller run'. That is a scheduling guess, not a synchronization point.

findings.title: The test adds a third bespoke socket-wrapping stack (test_socket_impl,…
findings.claim: The test adds a third bespoke socket-wrapping stack (test_socket_impl, test_connected_socket_impl, test_data_sink_impl) about 20 lines of pure forwarding next to the existing rpc_socket_impl/loopback error-injector infrastructure, and duplicates rpc_socket_impl's no-op reuseaddr overrides.

findings.title: test_data_sink_impl hardcodes `buffer_size()` to 8192 while forwarding every other…
findings.claim: test_data_sink_impl hardcodes `buffer_size()` to 8192 while forwarding every other data_sink_impl method to `_inner`.

findings.title: The new doc and API comment say the stream connection is shut down 'only once both…
findings.claim: The new doc and API comment say the stream connection is shut down 'only once both halves are closed'. The same doc, and client::abort_all_streams(), show that closing the client also aborts and shuts down the stream connection.

findings.title: The docs say 'Dropping an unclosed sink is an error'
findings.claim: The docs say 'Dropping an unclosed sink is an error'. It is in fact a fatal SEASTAR_ASSERT in ~sink_impl that aborts the process.

findings.title: The header comment on `_stream_closing` and the comment in stream_close() describe the…
findings.claim: The header comment on `_stream_closing` and the comment in stream_close() describe the same fact twice: it is set before the write buffer is closed, and send() refuses from then on.

findings.title: The stream-shutdown state is now spread across four loosely coupled members…
findings.claim: The stream-shutdown state is now spread across four loosely coupled members (`_sink_closed`, `_source_closed`, `_sink_closed_future`, `_stream_closing`) plus `_error`, with no single state type.

findings.title: `test_data_sink_impl` unconditionally overrides…
findings.claim: `test_data_sink_impl` unconditionally overrides `put(std::span<temporary_buffer<char>>)`, which exists only when `SEASTAR_API_LEVEL >= 9`. The repository's own loopback sink guards the same override with `#if`.

findings.title: The new `stream_close()` comment says `_outgoing_queue_ready` is exceptional "if an…
findings.claim: The new `stream_close()` comment says `_outgoing_queue_ready` is exceptional "if an entry failed". In `send()`, a failed entry resolves its `done` promise with a value.

findings.title: The new docs say the stream connection is shut down "only once both halves are closed",…
findings.claim: The new docs say the stream connection is shut down "only once both halves are closed", and commit 3 says that with one half closed "it is never shut down". Closing the parent client, or a connection error, also shuts it down.

findings.title: Only the client side of the fix is tested
findings.claim: Only the client side of the fix is tested. The server stream connection gets an identical unguarded hook, `[this] { return send({}); }`, from `server::connection::negotiate`, and the test captures `server_factory.hooks` but never fires them.

findings.title: The behavioral fix (commit f545c28a) lands without its regression test, which arrives…
findings.claim: The behavioral fix (commit f545c28a) lands without its regression test, which arrives separately in commit 5e25ebdb.

findings.title: stream_close() now waits for the whole outgoing queue to be written before it closes…
findings.claim: stream_close() now waits for the whole outgoing queue to be written before it closes write_buf and before it calls stop(). This adds an unbounded, uncancellable wait to sink.close().

findings.title: The commit messages carry Co-Authored-By: Claude trailers, and the PR body ends with a…
findings.claim: The commit messages carry Co-Authored-By: Claude trailers, and the PR body ends with a "Generated with Claude Code" line. The user's governing instructions forbid this attribution.

findings.title: The PR body references internal customer Jira tickets (CUSTOMER-666, CUSTOMER-678,…
findings.claim: The PR body references internal customer Jira tickets (CUSTOMER-666, CUSTOMER-678, SCYLLADB-4034) in a public open-source PR.

findings.title: The commit 1 message and the PR body say the same 141-byte frame was found unflushed on…
findings.claim: The commit 1 message and the PR body say the same 141-byte frame was found unflushed on the parent (non-stream) client too, but neither explains that case or says whether this fix covers it.

findings.title: The new stream_close() comment says _error is only set by the stop() that follows, but…
findings.claim: The new stream_close() comment says _error is only set by the stop() that follows, but other paths on the same stream connection set it independently.

findings.title: The names test_sink_state and test_data_sink_impl are vague
findings.claim: The names test_sink_state and test_data_sink_impl are vague. The classes actually park data_sink::close() until released and record put() calls made after close().

findings.title: hook_capturing_compressor_factory copies the pass-through compressor and factory…
findings.claim: hook_capturing_compressor_factory copies the pass-through compressor and factory boilerplate from test_compressor_empty_frames, including the empty-frame compress expression. It also gets around the const negotiate() with const_cast.

findings.title: The test's comments say an empty frame sent in the window 'must be refused' and that…
findings.claim: The test's comments say an empty frame sent in the window 'must be refused' and that catching closed_error is 'what we want', but nothing asserts that the frame was refused. A successful send() is accepted silently.

findings.title: The source doxygen and the docs say a source is released only by reading it to eof or…
findings.claim: The source doxygen and the docs say a source is released only by reading it to eof or error, and the docs advise asking the peer and then draining. This is an unbounded wait that depends on the peer cooperating, and the text does not say so.

findings.title: send() now refuses frames based on a second private flag, _stream_closing, but the…
findings.claim: send() now refuses frames based on a second private flag, _stream_closing, but the public error() accessor still reports only _error. A connection can be refusing sends while error() returns false.
